# JUDO DAO API

> Core Data Access Object interfaces for the JUDO runtime — defines the contract for CRUD, query, navigation, validation, and reference management on EMF-typed transfer objects.

Key facts:
- Java 21, single-module Maven project with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- Packaged as an OSGi bundle (`hu.blackbelt.judo.dao.api`)
- Pure API module — interfaces and one lightweight implementation (`PayloadImpl`), no persistence logic
- All DAO operations accept Eclipse EMF metaclass types (`EClass`, `EReference`, `EAttribute`), not Java classes
- Key dependencies: Eclipse EMF ECore, Jackson, Lombok, Google Guava
- Tests: JUnit 5, Mockito, Hamcrest
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Core API

- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/DAO.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/DAO.java): Main DAO interface — CRUD, search, count, navigation, reference management. Contains inner classes `OrderBy`, `Seek`, and `QueryCustomizer`
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/Payload.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/Payload.java): Data transfer object interface extending `Map<String, Object>` with factory methods and type-safe accessors
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/PayloadImpl.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/PayloadImpl.java): TreeMap-based Payload implementation with auto-wrapping of nested maps and JSON serialization via Jackson
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/PayloadValidator.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/PayloadValidator.java): Validation interface for payloads, references, and attributes against EMF-typed definitions
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/ValidationResult.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/ValidationResult.java): Validation result value class with code, level (ERROR/WARNING), location, and details
- [src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/IdentifierProvider.java](src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/dao/api/IdentifierProvider.java): Pluggable identifier generation interface
